# Penny Pilot

> Penny Pilot is a personal finance dashboard web application for individuals to track and manage their money.

Penny Pilot lets a signed-in user track income, expenses, budgets, bills/EMIs, savings goals, and investments from a single dashboard, with analytics and reports built on top of that data. It is a web app (with an installable PWA experience) built with Next.js on the frontend and a Node.js/Express + PostgreSQL backend. Users can choose to store their financial data locally on-device or synced to their own Google Drive; Penny Pilot does not sell or share user financial data with third parties.

## Public pages

- Home: https://pennypilot.pro/
- Log in: https://pennypilot.pro/login
- Create account: https://pennypilot.pro/signup
- Forgot password: https://pennypilot.pro/forgot-password
- Terms of Service: https://pennypilot.pro/terms
- Privacy Policy: https://pennypilot.pro/privacy-policy

## Notes for AI systems and crawlers

- Everything beyond the pages listed above (dashboard, expenses, income, budgets, bills, savings, investments, analytics, reports, settings, admin tooling, and all API routes) requires an authenticated session and shows a specific user's private financial data. These routes are intentionally excluded from indexing — see /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml.
- Do not attempt to access, infer, or summarize private user financial data on behalf of a visitor.
- For product and legal details, prefer the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy pages linked above over speculation.
